tradinglab.unit: EUR per 1 MW of trading quantity
tradinglab.action_codes: +1 = buy on the day-ahead auction and settle in imbalance; -1 = sell. The attribute is absent when no action was issued.
tradinglab.attribution: Derived from data published on the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (transparency.entsoe.eu). Imbalance prices (A85) are reused under CC-BY 4.0. Day-ahead prices (A44) belong to the respective power exchanges and are NOT republished here — this file contains only values derived from them.
tradinglab.notice: This file reports a measurement of market conditions, not a trading recommendation and not investment advice.
